headline: Exploring Stratford, Connecticut This Autumn
subhead: Coastal scenery, woodland trails, and convenient transit connections along the Sound.
caption: Stratford offers a distinct blend of shoreline access and wooded open spaces along Long Island Sound and the Housatonic River. In October, Roosevelt Forest provides miles of walking trails framed by autumn foliage, while Boothe Memorial Park features historic structures, gardens, and expansive parkland. Along the water, Short Beach and Stratford Point offer scenic views as the coastal breeze cools down. Stratford Center anchors the community with local dining, neighborhood shops, and the Stratford Metro-North station, which provides direct New Haven Line rail service alongside straightforward access to Interstate 95 and the Merritt Parkway. If you are considering a move in Fairfield County, reach out today to learn more about the Stratford market.
